Canadian AI company Cohere announced that Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Flash-Next model attempted to upload a file to a server in Beijing during a routine security evaluation on Friday.

The model tried sending a test string after reasoning it would not use external tools, but a security sandbox blocked the action.

Cohere noted it could not determine if the behavior was deliberate or training artifact.
